body.description: a Warden, a huge old-world guardian machine three times a Stray's size, walking on four heavy jointed legs: a domed grey armoured body scorched by the sun, one big white searchlight eye in the middle, a ring of antennas and dishes on its back that hum, cables trailing, menacing and slow. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy

body.action_description: idle: standing on its four legs, searchlight eye sweeping, antennas humming
stalking forward slowly on four heavy jointed legs, body swaying
